result.title: SPECTRUM: Proximal Spectral Modulation for Looped Self-Distillation
result.summary: A model that learns from its own outputs inherits more than their correctness: it inherits which solutions it produces. We formulate Looped Self-Distillation, a self-evolution framework for code generation in which a model repeatedly generates and learns from its own raw outputs, under a fixed information budget, without ongoing external assessment or test-based selection of the generated samples. We identify a consequential separation: correctness can improve while the breadth of correct implementations contracts. We introduce SPECTRUM, which re-estimates loss-sensitive key/value geometry from a fixed reference anchor at each round and converts it into full-rank proximal spectral modulation. All generated completions train a single student, whose subsequent inference requires no intervention. After five rounds of experiments on MBPP, SPECTRUM retains 89.9% of the initial model's 64-sample correct AST richness, compared with 66.4% for Vanilla self-distillation and 65.5% for a subspace-projection control. The advantage persists at matched correct-sample counts. Without further training or recalibration, the resulting student also achieves higher matched-correct richness than Vanilla SD on HumanEval+ and APPS Intro, demonstrating transfer of the diversity benefit. These findings establish correct-solution retention as a complementary objective of recursive self-improvement (RSI) and show that generation-time intervention can improve the solution repertoire retained by subsequent students.

AI.brief_summary: 该文提出 Looped Self-Distillation 自演化框架（代码生成、固定信息预算、无外部测试筛选），并指正正确率提升的同时正确解多样性收缩，进而设计 SPECTRUM：从固定参考锚点重估对损失敏感的 key/value 几何，转为满秩近端谱调制，以保留初始模型的正确解集合。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「循环自蒸馏 + 从固定锚点重估 KV 几何并做满秩调制」可能为 LVR 中循环状态更新、防止 latent 内容坍缩与保持推理轨迹多样性提供方法线索；但任务为纯代码文本、非视觉，需核查这种谱调制是否可迁移到多模态 latent 状态的几何约束。
